vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Nora taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: European Elder — named and noted.
Fireside lesson: Nora passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
🛡️ Vasyl, Nora, Giulia and Oliver met them at the door — 4 put down. Nora, Giulia, Oliver are hurt.
🛡️ Vasyl, Nora, Sam and Oliver met them at the door — 4 put down. Nora, Sam, Oliver are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl, Nora, Giulia and Oliver met them at the door — 4 put down. Vasyl, Giulia are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Cheyenne strikes the Elder The Big Beast.
Cheyenne hits Elder The Big Beast for 49.
Cheyenne hits Elder The Big Beast for 53.
Elder The Big Beast is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
(Elder The Big Beast's hide absorbs 6.)
You STRIKE the Elder The Big Beast for 43 (Hatchet).
The Elder The Big Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Big Beast!
📺 You brought down Elder The Big Beast. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Elder The Big Beast.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Bulldozer (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Nora, Cheyenne. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Nora strikes the Pack-leader Bulldozer.
Cheyenne strikes the Pack-leader Bulldozer.
The Pack-leader Bulldozer shifts, seeking a clear lane.
The Pack-leader Bulldozer falls.
📺 Nora, Cheyenne brought down Pack-leader Bulldozer, Bulldozer (packmate). Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl, Oliver and Sari met them at the door — 3 put down. Oliver, Sari are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Salvatore just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nora just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nora just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ursula, Zoltan and Yuki met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ursula, Zoltan, Yuki are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethan just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
